sources.title: 3D AI Studio - Generate 3D Models from Image or Text in Seconds
sources.snippet: How can I generate a 3D model with AI? 3D AI Studio offers multiple generation methods: Text to 3D lets you describe your model with a text prompt, Image to 3D converts images into 3D models, or use our Image Studio to edit and refine your image before converting it to 3D. Simply choose your preferred input method and let our AI handle the rest.
